[package]
name = "wow-ui-sim"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
description = "World of Warcraft UI simulator for addon development"
license = "GPL-3.0-only"
default-run = "wow-sim"
build = "build.rs"
autotests = false

[workspace]
members = [".", "xtask"]

[dependencies]
icu_casemap = { version = "=2.1.1", default-features = false, features = ["compiled_data"] }
icu_locale_core = { version = "=2.1.1", default-features = false, features = ["alloc"] }
icu_locale = { version = "=2.1.1", default-features = false, features = ["compiled_data"] }
icu_collator = { version = "=2.1.1", default-features = false, features = ["compiled_data"] }
icu_normalizer = { version = "=2.1.1", default-features = false, features = ["compiled_data"] }
icu_plurals = { version = "=2.1.1", default-features = false, features = ["compiled_data"] }
icu_properties = { version = "=2.1.2", default-features = false, features = ["compiled_data"] }
unicode-blocks = "=0.1.10"
fixed_decimal = { version = "=0.7.0", features = ["ryu"] }
icu_segmenter = { version = "=2.1.1", default-features = false, features = ["compiled_data", "auto"] }
# mlua removed — rilua is the sole Lua VM
rilua = { git = "https://github.com/Osso/rilua.git", rev = "842e4d3ff8592af45a5a93058eddf93419d29012" }
quick-xml = { version = "0.37", features = ["serialize"] }
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"
dirs = "5.0"
thiserror = "2.0"
tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter"] }
image = "0.25"
image-blp = "1"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["sync", "rt", "time"] }
libc = "0.2"
glob = "0.3"
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }
regex = "1"
walkdir = "2"
phf = { version = "0.11", features = ["macros"] }
phf_codegen = "0.11"
rodio = { version = "0.21", optional = true }
winapi = { version = "0.3", features = ["winuser"], optional = true }

# Iced GUI (optional, gated behind "gui" feature)
iced = { version = "0.14.0", optional = true, features = ["advanced", "canvas", "image", "tokio", "wgpu"] }
iced-dynamic = { path = "iced-dynamic", optional = true }
iced_wgpu = { version = "0.14", optional = true, path = "iced-wgpu-patched" }
iced_runtime = { version = "0.14", optional = true }
iced-layout-inspector = { git = "https://github.com/Osso/iced-layout-inspector.git", tag = "v0.2.0", optional = true }

# Text rendering
cosmic-text = "0.15"

# GPU rendering (optional, gated behind "gui" feature)
wgpu = { version = "27.0", optional = true }
bytemuck = { version = "1.21", features = ["derive"], optional = true }
pollster = { version = "0.4", optional = true }
webp = { version = "0.3.1", optional = true }
rustc-hash = "2.1.2"
asset-resolver = { git = "https://github.com/world-of-osso/asset-resolver", rev = "462097bba2aa72d1afed8e0ca5b7c7315096427d", optional = true }
cascette-client-storage = { git = "https://github.com/Osso/cascette-rs", rev = "758d8dbfbc64d500b2f8f5b5c133d9f82fa79a48", features = ["local-install"], optional = true }
cascette-crypto = { git = "https://github.com/Osso/cascette-rs", rev = "758d8dbfbc64d500b2f8f5b5c133d9f82fa79a48", optional = true }
cascette-formats = { git = "https://github.com/Osso/cascette-rs", rev = "758d8dbfbc64d500b2f8f5b5c133d9f82fa79a48", optional = true }
casc-extract = { git = "https://github.com/Osso/casc-extract", rev = "bbfb184066531b6eb674b50b63a6052eb871ab2f", optional = true }
reqwest = { version = "0.12", default-features = false, features = ["blocking", "rustls-tls"] }
httpdate = "1"
tar = "0.4.45"
flate2 = "1.1.9"
sha2 = "0.10"

[[bin]]
name = "wow-sim"
path = "src/bin/wow_sim/main.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "wow-cli"
path = "src/bin/wow_cli/main.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "bench_spellbook"
path = "src/bin/bench_spellbook.rs"
required-features = ["gui"]

[[bin]]
name = "bench_steady_state"
path = "src/bin/bench_steady_state.rs"
required-features = ["gui"]

[[example]]
name = "casc_smoke"
path = "examples/casc_smoke.rs"
required-features = ["casc"]

[dev-dependencies]
insta = "1.42"
pollster = "0.4"
tempfile = "3"

[features]
# fast-build is opt-in because the iced dylib hits MSVC's LNK1189 object limit
# on Windows. Local Linux dev/debug builds can use `--features fast-build` for
# faster incremental rebuilds. Release builds should use:
#   cargo build --release --no-default-features --features sound,gui,client-retail
# to produce a fully static binary not tied to a specific rustc version.
default = ["sound", "gui", "casc", "client-retail"]
sound = ["rodio", "casc"]
gui = ["casc", "dep:iced", "dep:iced_wgpu", "dep:iced_runtime", "dep:wgpu", "dep:iced-layout-inspector", "dep:pollster", "dep:bytemuck", "dep:webp", "dep:winapi"]
casc = ["dep:asset-resolver", "dep:cascette-client-storage", "dep:cascette-crypto", "dep:cascette-formats", "dep:casc-extract"]
fast-build = ["gui", "dep:iced-dynamic"]
rehash-stats = ["rilua/rehash-stats"]
intern-stats = ["rilua/intern-stats"]
# Retail API epoch features are cumulative patch gates. Client-channel
# features select one runtime profile and point at the current API epoch for
# that channel.
retail-12-0-0 = ["aura-instance-enumeration"]
retail-12-0-5 = ["retail-12-0-0", "native-duration-formatting", "base-spell-relationships"]
retail-12-0-7 = ["retail-12-0-5"]
retail-12-1-0 = ["retail-12-0-7", "aura-xml-widgets", "on-update-modes", "player-cast-durations", "forbidden-aspects", "numeric-rule-formatters", "aura-containers"]
retail-12-1-5 = ["retail-12-1-0", "timed-signal-maps", "forbidden-animation-aspects"]
# Private ICU duration rendering; this capability does not publish C_Intl.
native-duration-formatting = ["dep:cc", "dep:pkg-config", "dep:vcpkg"]
# Existing specialization relationship model shared by Retail 12.0.5+ and Forever.
base-spell-relationships = []
# Shared keyed timer capability used by PTR and Forever.
timed-signal-maps = []
# Shared XML aliases and intrinsic mappings for aura frames/buttons.
aura-xml-widgets = []
# Shared modeled AuraContainer option processors, enums and base aura secrecy queries.
aura-containers = ["aura-instance-enumeration"]
# Public aura ID queries shared by Retail 12.0+ and native aura containers.
aura-instance-enumeration = []
# Shared numeric frame update scheduling for Mainline and Forever.
on-update-modes = []
# Shared modeled player cast/channel lifecycle, identity tuples and duration queries.
player-cast-durations = []
# Shared forbidden-aspect state/query surface; animation bits arrived after Retail 12.1.
forbidden-aspects = []
forbidden-animation-aspects = ["forbidden-aspects"]
# Shared modeled numeric formatting rules for Retail 12.1+ and Forever.
numeric-rule-formatters = []

# Client profile features — exactly one profile marker must be enabled. The
# public client-retail bundle preserves the current retail epoch; profile-retail
# allows historical retail epoch tests against the same retail source cache.
profile-retail = []
client-retail = ["profile-retail", "retail-12-1-0"]
client-ptr = ["retail-12-1-5"]
client-wrath = []
client-mists = []
client-era = []
client-anniversary = []
client-wowforever = ["timed-signal-maps", "aura-xml-widgets", "on-update-modes", "player-cast-durations", "forbidden-animation-aspects", "numeric-rule-formatters", "aura-containers", "native-duration-formatting", "base-spell-relationships"]

[profile.release]
lto = false
debug = "line-tables-only"

[profile.dev]
incremental = true
lto = false
debug = "line-tables-only"
# Hit-grid rebuilds, layout resolution, and texture decode are pure data
# traversal; opt-level 0 makes them ~5-10x slower and visibly degrades GUI
# input latency in dev builds.
opt-level = 1
